methods.name: openRepository
methods.description: Open a repository for Jujutsu. Automatically initialize colocated JJ metadata for an existing Git checkout; preserve Git history and files. Does not create Git repositories, fetch or push. Call only when the user asked to open or enable Jujutsu for that folder.

methods.name: registerRepository
methods.description: Resolve a folder to its jj repository and return the repoId every other jujutsu tool takes. Read-only.

methods.name: registerRepositories
methods.description: Resolve up to 31 folders to their jj repositories in one call, reporting a null row per non-repository path instead of failing the batch. Read-only.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Repository status and the first page of the revision graph: root, revisions, changed paths, remotes and the last push. Read-only.

methods.name: graphPage
methods.description: Load the next revision graph page, or search all visible revisions with a query. Read-only.

methods.name: workspaces
methods.description: Every Jujutsu workspace of this repository with its folder, including workspaces no DSH project is registered for. Read-only.

methods.name: graphNavigation
methods.description: Resolve the current, main@origin, main and default-workspace landmarks in one call. Read-only.

methods.name: revisionRelationship
methods.description: Exact ancestry counts between two revisions and the bounded graph sets around them; the relation is relative to the target. Read-only.

methods.name: graphSlice
methods.description: One bounded graph slice: one revision history, or the history exclusive of other heads, bookmarks and workspaces. Read-only.

methods.name: referenceGraph
methods.description: A small revision graph around one chat reference — a revision or a bookmark — with its neighbourhood and the working copy, main, main@origin and default-workspace landmarks. Read-only.

methods.name: details
methods.description: One revision: its description, files, patch and evolution log. Read-only.

methods.name: revisionFiles
methods.description: Changed files and per-file stats for up to 40 revisions at once, the way the graph file list shows them. Read-only.

methods.name: editTimes
methods.description: When each revision's own content last changed, from its evolution log: rebases and description edits do not count. editedAt is null when the content never changed after the revision was created. Read-only.

methods.name: workingDiff
methods.description: The working-copy patch, for reading uncommitted changes without shelling out. Read-only.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepare one jujutsu action and return its preview: title, summary, detail and the previewId that jj_confirm_action applies. Preparing changes nothing. Call only when the user asked for that action; show them the summary before confirming. Actions: describe, split, squash, rebase, bookmark-move, bookmark-set, bookmark-delete, fetch, push, workspace-add, workspace-forget, workspace-edit, edit, new, commit, duplicate, abandon, revert, restore.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Apply one prepared jujutsu action by its previewId and return the command message and output. Call only when the user asked, after jj_prepare_action showed them the plan.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Files of which revisions were marked reviewed, keyed to the exact reviewed content. Read-only.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Mark or unmark one file of one revision reviewed. The Host stamps the review time.
